To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the most common teaching methods are discussion and lecture; (2) lecturers’ field of study, teaching experience and teaching practice are the main factors affecting teaching methods; and (3) there is a gap between the teaching methods preferred by the lecturers and those they actually use.
The current practice of teaching is influenced by the lecturer’s field and teaching experiences.
